description: The meter's first night on the rig, 2026-11-19 17:29 to 2026-11-20 09:08 UTC: 277 raw edges from gpiomon v2.2.1 (both edges, bias pull-up, NO debounce, realtime clock) on GPIO 27, with the Pi's internal pull-up only. 15 edges, in 8 clusters, are microsecond spikes that report the level the line already had, most within a second of the boiler programmer switching CH or HW. Draws: a bath (35 L) and its top-up (23 L), a slow tap (9 L), three sinks (2 L each), a shower (56 L), and two lone pulses (18:03:29, 09:08:43). Counting every falling edge gives 140.
source: real capture: gpiomon -c gpiochip0 -b pull-up -E realtime -F '%S %e' 27; lines are epoch_seconds.ns and the edge (1 rising = opens, 2 falling = closes)
anchors_why: 452 ms: the first bath litre. 26.989 s: the slow tap's wheel paused mid-turn. 4 h 26 m 26.631 s: the pointer resting on the magnet from 18:03:29 (counted) to 22:29:56, through two spikes. 32 m 20.211 s: the sink's last litre, resting until 23:02:44. 1.832 s: the first bath interval.
